Confirm the DOI resolves before publish.

claim_en: Affiliations in full text: UC Berkeley, Caltech BBE, Princeton Neuroscience Institute, HHMI (Tsao).
claim_zh_tw: 全文所列單位：UC Berkeley、Caltech BBE、Princeton Neuroscience Institute、HHMI（Tsao）。

claim_en: Tsao is Chief Scientist for Neuro at the Astera Institute.
claim_zh_tw: Tsao 為 Astera Institute 神經科學首席科學家。
notes: inv#2 (Astera part). Press-sourced only.

claim_en: Tatiana Engel (Princeton) did the computational analysis.
claim_zh_tw: Tatiana Engel（普林斯頓）負責計算分析。
notes: Press only.

claim_en: Paradigm is binocular flash suppression (a rivalry variant), not classic free rivalry.
claim_zh_tw: 實驗範式為雙眼閃光抑制（雙眼競爭的變體），並非典型自由競爭。
notes: inv#7 (BFS part). Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Describing the 2026 experiment simply as 'binocular rivalry' is imprecise.
claim_zh_tw: 將 2026 實驗簡稱為「雙眼競爭」不夠精確（應為閃光抑制）。
notes: Related to inv#7. Tsao's own thread says 'during rivalry' (secondary), so loose usage exists; prefer 'binocular flash suppression, a rivalry variant'.

claim_en: A priming image goes to one eye for 1 or 2 s, then a second image is flashed to the other eye; the flashed image usually dominates.
claim_zh_tw: 前導刺激圖像先給一眼 1 或 2 秒，再對另一眼閃現第二張圖，閃現圖通常占優勢。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Experiment 1: priming 2 s, test 4 s, blank 500 ms; 10 faces forming 25 pairs; 7 sessions monkey A + 3 monkey M.
claim_zh_tw: 實驗一：前導刺激 2 秒、測試 4 秒、空白 500 毫秒；10 張臉組成 25 對；猴 A 7 場、猴 M 3 場。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Experiment 2: priming 1 s, test 1 s, blank 250 ms; 1500 faces forming 750 pairs; 60-face subset about 20 trials per condition; 5 sessions A + 4 M.
claim_zh_tw: 實驗二：前導刺激 1 秒、測試 1 秒、空白 250 毫秒；1500 張臉組成 750 對；60 張臉子集每條件約 20 次試驗；猴 A 5 場、猴 M 4 場。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Stimuli presented dichoptically via red/cyan anaglyph goggles; 7 deg stimuli; 60 x 44 deg LCD.
claim_zh_tw: 以紅／青色立體眼鏡進行雙眼分視；刺激 7 度；60 × 44 度液晶螢幕。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Two male rhesus macaques (monkey A and M) were recorded.
claim_zh_tw: 記錄了 2 隻雄性恆河猴（猴 A、猴 M）。
notes: inv#4. Authors list 'only two monkeys' as a limitation. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Neuropixels 1.0 NHP probes with Kilosort3 spike sorting; single and multi-units.
claim_zh_tw: 使用 Neuropixels 1.0 NHP 探針，Kilosort3 分類尖峰；含單單元與多單元。
notes: inv#5 (Neuropixels part). Single-trial analysis is verified in F29.

claim_en: Recorded IT face patches ML and AM (fMRI-localized) and PFC patches PO (orbitofrontal) and PVL (ventrolateral).
claim_zh_tw: 記錄下顳葉臉部斑塊 ML、AM（fMRI 定位）與前額葉斑塊 PO（眶額葉）、PVL（腹外側）。
notes: inv#6. Fig.1 legend wording: 'lateral orbitofrontal sulcus and infraprincipal dimple'. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: 3501 visually responsive neurons across sessions.
claim_zh_tw: 跨場次共 3501 個視覺反應神經元。
notes: inv#5 (thousands of neurons). Press 'thousands' is consistent with this total. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: PFC analysis used 661 neurons (300 PCA components; IT used 500).
claim_zh_tw: 前額葉分析使用 661 個神經元（300 個主成分；IT 為 500）。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Example raster shows 429 simultaneously recorded cells.
claim_zh_tw: 範例放電點陣圖含 429 個同時記錄細胞。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Tuning-gain analysis used 543 cells.
claim_zh_tw: 調諧增益分析使用 543 個細胞。
source_ref: research/raw/web_biorxiv_hesse2026_fulltext.md Subjects and recording; research/raw/web_tsao_x_and_press.md Other secondary coverage
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Session counts: 9 main state analyses; 19 two-state vs one-state; 10 single-trial decoding; 7 of 9 cross-region.
claim_zh_tw: 場次數：主要狀態分析 9；雙狀態對單狀態 19；單次試驗解碼 10；跨區域 7（共 9 中）。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Monkeys made no report; monkey states were inferred from neural activity (LLR + HMM).
claim_zh_tw: 猴子不作報告；其狀態由神經活動（LLR + HMM）推論。
notes: inv#7 (HMM/LLR part). Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: In 2026 the monkeys' percept was inferred from eye movements.
claim_zh_tw: 2026 年猴子的知覺由眼動推論。
notes: Eye-movement inference belongs to the 2020 eLife paper; the 2026 text does not describe it. Guard against this mix-up. Per raw summary (visible text does not describe it); check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Percept validated in 14 human participants by button press; flashed percept reported on 82% of trials.
claim_zh_tw: 知覺以 14 位人類受試者按鍵驗證；82% 試驗報告看到閃現圖。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Human validation stats: flashed vs primed t(13)=9.4, p=4e-7; window 300-1000 ms after flash; latency 0.86 +/- 0.05 s.
claim_zh_tw: 人類驗證統計：閃現對前導刺激 t(13)=9.4，p=4e-7；分析窗為閃現後 300–1000 毫秒；報告潛時 0.86 ± 0.05 秒。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Binocular modulation averaged over neurons is weak: slope 0.23 vs unambiguous (5550 cell-stimulus pairs, p=8e-133).
claim_zh_tw: 平均雙眼調變微弱：相對無歧義條件斜率 0.23（5550 個細胞—刺激配對，p=8e-133）。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Population alternates between conscious and suppressed micro-epochs about 15 times per second.
claim_zh_tw: 族群約每秒 15 次在意識與被抑制微時段間交替。
notes: inv#9. Abstract is a paraphrase in raw. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Single-trial analysis (Poisson LLR in 10 ms bins; two-state Poisson HMM) is used to label micro-epochs.
claim_zh_tw: 以單次試驗分析（10 毫秒時間窗（bin）的 Poisson LLR；雙狀態 Poisson HMM）標記微時段。
notes: inv#7 (10 ms is a bin width; the video note's '10 ms 時段' should not be read as epoch length). HMM bins are 5 ms. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Likelihood autocorrelation time constant is 67 ms (mean dwell 67 ms, median about 46 ms).
claim_zh_tw: 概似自相關時間常數為 67 毫秒（平均停留 67 毫秒，中位數約 46 毫秒）。
notes: inv#9 (about 60 ms). Say 'roughly 60 ms'. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: HMM median dwell 64 ms (state 1) and 59 ms (state 2); plateau near 60 ms across bin sizes.
claim_zh_tw: HMM 中位停留時間：狀態一 64 毫秒、狀態二 59 毫秒；跨時間窗大小約在 60 毫秒平穩。
notes: inv#9. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Alternation is more than an order of magnitude faster than rivalry switches (about 0.5 Hz).
claim_zh_tw: 交替速度比競爭切換（約 0.5 Hz）快一個數量級以上。
notes: 0.5 Hz is the full-text figure for rivalry. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: In state 1, conscious-face explained variance exceeds 80% for some features (priming ceiling above 90%); suppressed face near chance; reversed in state 2.
claim_zh_tw: 狀態一中，意識臉部的解釋變異在部分特徵超過 80%（前導刺激上限逾 90%）；被抑制臉接近機率水準；狀態二則相反。
notes: inv#12 (reconstruction). The qualifier 'some features' is essential. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: The 700 ms time-averaged reconstruction is a blurred superposition of both faces.
claim_zh_tw: 700 毫秒時間平均重建為兩張臉的模糊疊加。
notes: inv#12. Not in raw full text (which has an averaging-model comparison, F45, not a 700 ms blur).

claim_en: Single-trial 10-class decoding (chance 10%): full window 40% conscious / 34% suppressed.
claim_zh_tw: 單次試驗十類解碼（機率 10%）：整個視窗意識 40%、被抑制 34%。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: State-1 decoding: over 61% conscious vs 4% suppressed (t(9)=11.0, p=2e-6); state 2 reversed (t(9)=-13.7, p=3e-7).
notes: inv#13 (>60%). This is state-1 accuracy, not overall accuracy. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Held-out neurons: EV t(29)=17.5, p=6e-17; state 1 t(9)=7.6, p=3e-5; state 2 t(9)=-6.5, p=1e-4.
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Two-state model beats one-state model in all 19 sessions (t(18)=4.84, p=1e-4).
claim_zh_tw: 雙狀態模型在全部 19 場次均優於單狀態模型（t(18)=4.84，p=1e-4）。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Single-cell tuning gain ratio 1.21 (conscious-in-state-1 vs suppressed-in-state-2), r=0.90.
claim_zh_tw: 單細胞調諧增益比 1.21（狀態一意識對狀態二被抑制），r=0.90。
notes: inv#14 (about 21% higher is a derived restatement of 1.21). Check PDF before publish. p-value for this comparison: see F40.

claim_en: Conscious gain in state 1 vs suppressed gain in state 2: p = 3x10^-40 (mean ratio 1.21, r = 0.90).
claim_zh_tw: 狀態一意識增益對狀態二被抑制增益的比較：p = 3×10^-40（平均比 1.21，r = 0.90）。
source_ref: research/raw/web_biorxiv_hesse2026_fulltext.md Results (IT) "Single-cell gain" (line restored by orchestrator 2026-10-29; same section also has p = 8x10^-95 and p = 6x10^-60 for within-state gain comparisons)
notes: inv#14 (p-value part). Verified = consistent with the raw model-summary of the bioRxiv page, not verbatim. Check PDF before publish. Cite together with the comparison (conscious vs suppressed gain), not as an effect size; the effect size is the ratio 1.21 (F39). Earlier "unverified" status was due to the line being omitted from raw; now corrected.

claim_en: Mean firing rate is slightly higher in state 2; a linear decoder separates the two states with 66% accuracy.
claim_zh_tw: 狀態二平均放電率略高；線性解碼器以 66% 準確率區分兩種狀態。
notes: inv#16. Not contradictory with gain 1.21: different measures (feature-tuning gain vs mean rate). Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Same neurons switch content; no separate conscious and suppressed populations.
claim_zh_tw: 同一批神經元切換內容；並無分開的意識與被抑制族群。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: After gain equalization the residual binocular-unambiguous correlation disappears (r=-0.02, p=0.31): averaging explains the weak modulation.
claim_zh_tw: 增益等化後，雙眼與無歧義條件的殘餘相關消失（r=-0.02，p=0.31）：平均效應可解釋微弱調變。
notes: inv#17 (core). Authors' word is 'explains'; the 'entirely / 30 years' version is F44. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: The past 30 years of weak modulation were entirely due to time-averaging cancelling opposite strong signals.
claim_zh_tw: 過去 30 年的微弱調變「完全」是反向強訊號時間平均抵消所致。
notes: inv#17 (overstated part). Full text supports averaging as an explanation in this dataset, not 'entirely' or '30 years'. Status changed unverified to contradicted (QA #12): raw says averaging "explains" the weak modulation, not "entirely"/"30 years". Per raw summary; check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Controls: shuffled templates give EV<0; On/Off gain fluctuations do not explain states (kappa about 0); averaging, conscious-only and uncoordinated models each fail at least 3 of 4 tests; real data beat averaging model by dEV 8.2% (p=0.007).
claim_zh_tw: 對照：打亂模板 EV<0；On/Off 增益波動無法解釋狀態（kappa 約 0）；平均、僅意識、非協調模型各至少未通過 4 項檢定中的 3 項；真實資料勝過平均模型 ΔEV 8.2%（p=0.007）。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Initial reconstruction analysis was circular; authors addressed it with held-out neurons.
claim_zh_tw: 最初重建分析具循環性；作者以留出神經元處理。
notes: Authors state this as a limitation. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: ML and AM switching rhythms are weakly coordinated; authors say results 'do not provide strong evidence' for it.
claim_zh_tw: ML 與 AM 切換節律協調微弱；作者表示結果「未提供強證據」。
notes: inv#15. Keep the wording hedged.

claim_en: IT and PFC both alternate between conscious and suppressed content.
claim_zh_tw: IT 與 PFC 皆在意識與被抑制內容間交替。
source_ref: research/raw/web_biorxiv_hesse2026_fulltext.md Abstract; Results (PFC); research/raw/web_tsao_x_and_press.md Tsao on X
notes: inv#10 (alternation in both areas). PFC is described as 'qualitatively similar'.

claim_en: IT and PFC switch synchronously at about 15 Hz (cross-region synchrony).
claim_zh_tw: IT 與 PFC 以約 15 Hz 同步切換。
source_ref: research/01_notes_inventory.md claim 10 vs research/raw/web_biorxiv_hesse2026_fulltext.md (cross-region analysis in 7 of 9 sessions, outcome not captured)
notes: inv#10 (synchrony part). Raw gives no cross-region result; ML-AM coordination is weak (F47). Do not claim synchrony.

claim_en: PFC reconstruction quality is lower: priming EV below 80%, below 30% for shape features.
claim_zh_tw: PFC 重建品質較低：前導刺激 EV 低於 80%，形狀特徵低於 30%。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: PFC state 1 tracks the conscious face and state 2 the suppressed face: EV t(29)=14.2, p=1e-14; decoding p=1e-5 (n=30 pairs); held-out halves EV p=3e-4, decoding p=0.03; slopes 0.91 and -0.52.
claim_zh_tw: PFC 狀態一追蹤意識臉、狀態二追蹤被抑制臉：EV t(29)=14.2，p=1e-14；解碼 p=1e-5（n=30 對）；留出半數 EV p=3e-4、解碼 p=0.03；斜率 0.91 與 -0.52。
notes: Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Authors say the alternation 'may therefore be a broad cortical phenomenon'.
claim_zh_tw: 作者表示此交替「因此可能是廣泛的皮質現象」。
notes: Hedged; generalization is untested. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: The suppressed stimulus is not a weak residue; it occupies the same face space in its own epochs.
claim_zh_tw: 被抑制刺激並非微弱殘餘；在其自身時段占據與意識臉相同的臉空間。
notes: Authors' interpretation. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Open question: why do some micro-epochs reach awareness and others do not? Routing to report/action is speculation; switching mechanism unknown.
claim_zh_tw: 開放問題：為何有些微時段達到意識而其他沒有？路由至報告／行動為推測；切換機制未知。
notes: Authors' stated limitations. Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: The Discussion links timing to attentional sampling, theta-phase working-memory access, orbitofrontal alternation, hippocampal theta flickering; it does not cite GNWT/IIT or alpha.
claim_zh_tw: 討論將時間尺度連結至注意力取樣、theta 相位工作記憶存取、眶額葉交替、海馬迴 theta 閃爍；未明確引用 GNWT／IIT，亦未討論 alpha。
notes: Framing the paper as a GNWT-vs-IIT verdict is our interpretation, not the authors'. 15 Hz is not theta (4-8 Hz) (03 s6). Check PDF before publish.

claim_en: Tsao: 'We have not shown that consciousness has a frame rate.'
claim_zh_tw: Tsao：「我們並未證明『意識有影格率』。」
notes: Truncated snippet via search; only point 1 of four seen; X returned HTTP 402.

claim_en: 'Consciousness has a frame rate' / 'consciousness is a 15-times-a-second flicker'.
claim_zh_tw: 「意識有影格率」／「意識是每秒 15 次的閃爍」。
source_ref: research/raw/web_tsao_x_and_press.md Other secondary coverage; Clarification thread
notes: Contradicted by the lead author's clarification and by the full-text scope (IT/PFC content alternation only). Do not state.

claim_en: Consciousness depends on many brain areas; the paper reports only a few select nodes.
claim_zh_tw: 意識依賴多個腦區；本文僅報告少數選定節點。
notes: Search-summary paraphrase, not a verbatim quote.

claim_en: Tsao launch thread: findings 'overturn decades of thinking' and show 'a pure correlate of conscious awareness'.
claim_zh_tw: Tsao 發文稱發現「推翻數十年的想法」並呈現「意識覺知的純粹相關」。
notes: Promotional framing; not for neutral factual statements.

claim_en: Authors say findings 'expose a limitation of searching for NCC within the average activity of specific brain regions'.
claim_zh_tw: 作者表示研究結果「揭示在特定腦區平均活動中尋找 NCC 的限制」。
notes: Press-reported author statement.

claim_en: Glitchwire caveats: not peer reviewed; only 2 monkeys; 'timing, not area' framing goes beyond preprint.
claim_zh_tw: Glitchwire 提醒：未經同儕審查；僅 2 隻猴；「時機而非腦區」框架超出預印本所示。
notes: Commentary, not authors' claim.

claim_en: The first author and Tsao call this the most important breakthrough of their careers.
claim_zh_tw: 第一作者與曹穎稱此為職涯最重要突破。
notes: inv#18. Only in video note, no source; do not cite.

claim_en: Analyst rating that the evidence is 'moderate to strong'.
claim_zh_tw: 分析者評分證據「中等至強」。
notes: inv#19. Note-writer's subjective rating, not a paper claim; do not cite as fact.

claim_en: 2020 eLife numbers (human 93%, ML 57%, AM 73%) are 2020 results, not 2026.
claim_zh_tw: 93%（人類）、57%（ML）、73%（AM）為 2020 eLife 的數字，並非 2026 結果。
notes: inv#20. Numbers are not in the inputs (source unconfirmed), so status is unverified, not contradicted (QA #10). Guardrail kept: if used at all, they are 2020 numbers and must NOT be attributed to 2026 (the 2026 human validation number is 82%, F25). Do not use.

claim_en: The 2026 research has a 'perception stable period of 700 ms'.
claim_zh_tw: 2026 研究的「感知穩定期」為 700 毫秒。
notes: inv#8. Not in raw full text; paradigm durations are 1-4 s (F12, F13).

claim_en: Conscious micro-epoch signal discriminability returns to the level of stimulus presented alone.
claim_zh_tw: 意識微時段的信號區分度恢復至單獨呈現之水平。
notes: inv#11. Raw gives priming ceiling >90% and state-1 EV >80% for some features, not an 'alone' comparison; do not cite.

claim_en: State 1 reconstructs the seen face and state 2 the unseen face (about 60 ms states).
claim_zh_tw: 狀態一重建看見的臉、狀態二重建未看見的臉（約 60 毫秒狀態）。
notes: inv#12 (state part); dwell from F30-F31.

claim_en: Hesse & Tsao 2020, eLife 9:e58360: no-report paradigm; percept inferred from eye movements; IT face cells track percept; perceived and suppressed stimuli decodable on single trials.
claim_zh_tw: Hesse 與 Tsao 2020，eLife 9:e58360：無報告範式；以眼動推論知覺；IT 臉部細胞追蹤知覺；單次試驗可解碼被知覺與被抑制刺激。

claim_zh_tw: Shi 等人 2026，Nature，DOI 10.1038/s41586-026-10267-3：臉部細胞經一次小於 20 毫秒的族群協同事件切換編碼；僅限臉部。

claim_en: Publication date of Shi et al. 2026 is discrepant: Mar 25 2026 (Caltech news) vs May 7 2026 (Caltech repository).
claim_zh_tw: Shi 等人 2026 發表日期不一致：2026-03-25（Caltech 新聞）對 2026-05-07（Caltech 典藏）。
notes: Unresolved; check the Nature page. Preprint bioRxiv 2023-12-06 (10.1101/2023.12.06.570341).

claim_en: Kingir et al. 2025 bioRxiv: fixation shifts in a no-report rivalry paradigm induce saccade-related perceptual switches.
claim_zh_tw: Kingir 等人 2025 bioRxiv：無報告雙眼競爭範式中的注視轉移誘發與眼跳相關的知覺切換。
notes: Title and link only; contents unverified. Preprint.

claim_en: Cogitate Consortium 2025 (Nature, Apr 30 2025): 256 human participants; fMRI, MEG, iEEG; preregistered.
claim_zh_tw: Cogitate Consortium 2025（Nature，2025-04-30）：256 位人類受試者；fMRI、MEG、iEEG；預先註冊。
notes: Source is a press report (idw), not the Nature paper.

claim_en: Cogitate 2025: no sustained posterior synchronization (challenges IIT); lack of ignition at stimulus offset and limited PFC representation of some conscious dimensions (challenges GNWT); neither theory decisively confirmed or refuted.
